events.strDescriptionEN:
The 2026 TOTO Japan Classic was won by Japan’s Shuri Sakuma, who shot a final-round 8-under 64 to secure her first career LPGA Tour title on Sunday, 8 November 2026.
The tournament, which serves as the finale of the LPGA Tour's late-season Asian swing, was held at the Taiheiyo Club Minori Course in Omitama, Ibaraki, Japan. Sakuma came from three strokes behind on the final day, finishing with a 72-hole total of 20-under 268 to claim the $315,000 winner's prize and earn eligibility to join the LPGA Tour.
